name: Luisa Mao

papers.title: Scaled Preference Conditioning for Terrain Costmap Generation
papers.abstract: Successful autonomous robot navigation in off-road domains requires the ability to generate high-quality terrain costmaps that are able to both generalize well over a wide variety of terrains and rapidly adapt relative costs at test time to meet mission-specific needs. Existing approaches for costmap generation allow for either rapid test-time adaptation of relative costs (e.g., semantic segmentation methods) or generalization to new terrain types (e.g., representation learning methods), but not both. In this work, we present \textit{scaled preference conditioned all-terrain costmap generation} (\textsc{spacer}), a novel approach for generating terrain costmaps that leverages synthetic data during training in order to generalize well to new terrains, and allows for rapid test-time adaptation of relative costs by conditioning on a user-specified \textit{scaled preference context}. Using large-scale aerial maps, we show that \textsc{spacer} achieves the lowest \textit{regret} across varied preferences in five of seven environments for global path planning and generates costmaps from the RELLIS dataset with up to 13\% lower mean absolute error when compared to the ground-truth costmap than the next best methods.
